d:
This is Yusuf's Kate Masale Ka Chicken. A dish from my father-in-law's childhood, rooted in his memories, cooked once in earthen pots over coal by grandmothers and aunts, now passed down to me as legacy.
No extra water. No spice pastes. Just whole spices, caramelised onions, and the slow-cooked magic of chicken in its own juices - the way he always made it.
We pair it with Arahar dal and hot rotis. Simple. Soulful. A meal that brings peace before it brings hunger.
He is no longer with us, but his vibrant nature, his love, and this recipe - they aren't going anywhere. We will meet again
